Group Disrupts 'I Am Malala' Reading Session in Ahmedabad

In Ahmedabad, Gujarat, a group identified as Bajrang Dal workers allegedly attacked participants at a reading session for Malala Yousafzai's book, 'I Am Malala'. The incident occurred during a session organized by the Gujarat Pradesh Congress Committee. Police have registered a case and detained three individuals in connection with the disruption. The event has also sparked political commentary regarding the book and the alleged attack.
